How many students have got marks less than 10 in Mathematics?
solution:
**Given:**

Number of students getting more than 10 marks in mathematics = 92

**Calculation:**

Total number of students = 100

Number of students getting more than 10 marks in mathematics = 92

Number of students getting less than 10 marks in mathematics = Total Students - Number of students getting more than 10 marks in mathematics

⇒ 100 - 92 = 8

**∴ Number of students getting less then 10 marks in mathematics is 8.**
